uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
2034-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie Cat, adding {C}{C}
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Repeat.
2034-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

2946-4871-5670-7192.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4871-5670-7192.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5670-7192.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Grave Venerations and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

512-7014-7203.easyPrerequisites: Brigid and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-7014-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures
512-7014-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Brigid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-7014-7203.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Brigid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

586-864-2267-3125-4247.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2267-3125-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

777-1170-5131-6798--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
777-1170-5131-6798--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

2281-2523-2869.description:
Activate Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing it.
When Saffi Eriksdotter dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Saffi Eriksdotter that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Saffi Eriksdotter ability.
Repeat using the Saffi Eriksdotter token

924-4149-4599-4871-6968.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-4149-4599-4871-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-4149-4599-4871-6968.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-4149-4599-4871-6968.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

2829-3764-7363.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the Mutagen.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-2829-6972.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

3678-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4740-5220-5686-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
4740-5220-5686-6900.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying X life, where X is the creature's mana value.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
4740-5220-5686-6900.notes: Your starting life total will need to be at least a certain number depending on the mana value of the creature you are sacrificing to perform this combo. This list shows the minimum life total you would need to have, from mana value 1 (left) to 10 (right): 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46, 56. You can also cast spells to reduce the needed life to start.

2403-4771-5220-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

560-1874-2034-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-1874-2034-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

4321-5777-6692.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
4321-5777-6692.description:
Activate Wicked Wolf by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Wicked Wolf ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

292-4968-6627.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-4968-6627.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

500-851-2523-2557.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Adrix and Nev and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Adrix and Nev token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Adrix and Nevs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Adrix and Nevs you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-851-2523-2557.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^308.0343553279263) creature tokens.

2060-3574-4222-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3574-4222-4772.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3574-4222-4772.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

880-3703-4826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-3703-4826.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2061-2187-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Walk each turn.
2061-2187-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1809-1987-2104-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1809-1987-2104-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

1558-3455-3529-4231.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Many Faces is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3455-3529-4231.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

360-2161-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
360-2161-3490-4050.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

2433-3490-5231.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
2433-3490-5231.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Rosie triggers, targeting any creature except the Servo.
Holding priority, Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Rosie ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature.
Repeat from step 2.

1727-2506-5147.description:
Cast Moorland Rescuer by paying {5}{W}.
Moorland Rescuer enters the battlefield and triggers Molten Echoes, creating a token copy of Moorland Rescuer with haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken Moorland Rescuer.
The nontoken Moorland Rescuer dies, triggering itself.
In response, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the token Moorland Rescuer.
The token Moorland Rescuer dies, triggering itself, returning the nontoken Moorland Rescuer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Molten Echoes triggers again, creating a token copy of Moorland Rescuer with haste.
Resolve a Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the remaining Moorland Rescuer trigger, returning any number of creature cards with total power 4 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield and failing to exile the Moorland Rescuer which has left the graveyard.
Resolve the remaining Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.

543-1887-2021.notablePrerequisites: Colossus of Akros is not monstrous.
543-1887-2021.description:
Activate Colossus of Akros by paying {10}, putting twenty +1/+1 counters on it and causing it to become monstrous.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting forty growth counters on itself.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

851-1308-3209-4772.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback for {4}{G}, creating eight 1/1 green Saproling token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback, tapping five green 1/1 Saproling tokens to pay for it using convoke.
Repeat from step 2.

760-4971.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
760-4971.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, targeting Swans of Bryn Argoll.
The damage that would be dealt to Swans of Bryn Argoll is prevented, and you draw a card instead.
Repeat from step 2.

2843-3175-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

873-3584-5261.notablePrerequisites: You control a land, artifact, or creature that can produce mana.
873-3584-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Twiddle.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Twiddle for each other instant or sorcery you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve a copy of Twiddle, untapping Isochron Scepter.
If there is a remaining copy of Twiddle on the stack, resolve it, untapping a mana-producing land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until there are no more copies of Twiddle.
Repeat from step 1.
